pages.text: Place one kind of speed upgrade in the generator’s upgrade slot. A stack sets the speed to the stack size multiplied by the tier bonus. Faster burns make more FE per tick without changing the total energy in the fuel.
Speed Upgrade uses 1.05× the stack size as its burn speed.
Enchanted Speed Upgrade uses 1.10× the stack size.
Super Speed Upgrade uses 1.20× the stack size.

pages.title: Sizing the Output
pages.text: The generator can only start or continue a burn step when the buffer can fit that step. A stronger upgrade can make an undersized receiver easier to notice.$(br2)Quarry upgrades are adjacent blocks with their own rules.
